description: Scope dimension of the FCF Canonical System Map. Scope answers: 'does version X own this node?' — it is orthogonal to Hierarchy (progressive disclosure) and View (current granularity). A lens scope drives a coloring pass on the SAME single cell per node (no duplicated instances, no scope x view layer multiplication).

classes.BOUNDARY: consumed or produced across the version boundary; internals not owned
classes.OUT: exists in the overall system; not handled by the version — grayed but never hidden

scopes.label: OVERALL
scopes.comment: No scope clipping or coloring; the whole system in neutral colors.

scopes.basis: Per Production Pilot v0.1 directive: SPATIAL subtree ACTIVE; upstream nodes consumed by Bake are BOUNDARY (minimum necessary boundary only); the rest OUT. BOUNDARY membership rule: 'upstream, consumed by the current Bake, internals not owned by this task'.
